item.title: Qpack Amplification Vulnerabilities Expose HTTP/3 Servers
item.description: Recent findings reveal that Qpack compression mechanisms in HTTP/3 servers can be weaponized for amplification attacks, highlighting persistent oversight in modern protocol implementations.

item.title: Autonomous Vulnerability Discovery Collides with Patch Latency
item.description: As multi-agent systems accelerate the discovery of global software flaws faster than manual remediation can keep pace, security teams face a widening window of exposure driven by automated discovery pipelines.

item.title: A Sub-Quadratic Shift in Integer Multiplication
item.description: Recent work proposes an $O(n \log n)$ integer multiplication algorithm, trimming asymptotic overhead while testing whether practical implementations will ever displace decades of optimized, hardware-specific assembly routines.

OpenAI Models Find a Home on Google Cloud
item.description: OpenAI models are now available within Google Cloud infrastructure, bridging a notable enterprise divide between the two firms. This integration simplifies deployment for corporate clients, though it deepens dependencies on a shrinking pool of foundational providers.

item.title: Railway Halts Deployments After Unauthorized Access to Encrypted Variables
item.description: Cloud deployment platform Railway paused all builds following a security incident where external parties may have accessed and partially decrypted customer environment variables containing sensitive keys and credentials. The primary tradeoff forces developers to choose between immediate platform-locked downtime or leaving exposed downstream production credentials unrotated.
